description: This file contains JavaScript functions for managing portal sites in the vtiger CRM system, including fetching, saving, deleting sites, and URL handling.

methods.name: fetchAddSite
methods.description: Fetches and displays a form or data to add a new site based on the provided ID.

methods.name: fetchContents
methods.description: Loads portal content based on the specified mode, either reloading the page or fetching via AJAX.

methods.name: DeleteSite
methods.description: Deletes a portal site after user confirmation.

methods.name: SaveSite
methods.description: Validates and saves portal site data via AJAX.

methods.name: setSite
methods.description: Sets the current site based on selected URL list.

methods.name: defaultMysites
methods.description: Sets default site value via AJAX.

methods.name: OnUrlChange
methods.description: Handles URL change event, removing protocol prefix from the URL input.
